dogecoin.text:
Basic Attention Token (BAT) > Dogecoin.

Why.... because the Brave browser uses it.

So far as of now, 1 BAT = $0.58 USD > 1 Doge = about $0.05 USD.

It's harder to earn DOGE than BAT.

To date, it's pointless to invest in the Chia coin (due to low value) which is perfect for low-power mining using a SSD with very high endurance. Also pointless to invest is the Shiba Inu coin, coined as the Dogecoin killer, which has a low value like Doge back last year.
Unpopular opinion: Anything Elon Musk does with money and/or shares somehow impact the price of Dogecoin. It happened today.

So it's happening anyway, and  I want my edit button now.

Next up, Dogecoin/Shiba Inu to the moon?
